description: Machine-enforceable rules for OpenCode agents. CRITICAL = BLOCK agent. HIGH = FLAG orchestrator. LOW = advisory.

required_mcps.description: MCPs required for the framework to function. Preflight.sh checks these dynamically.

lean-ctx.description: Context persistence — contract storage and retrieval

gitnexus.description: Code intelligence — impact analysis before edits

graphify.description: Knowledge graph — codebase exploration (depends on gitnexus index)

rules.description: Per-session token budget must not exceed max_per_session
Warning emitted when usage exceeds warning_threshold_pct
Subagent calls must not exceed max_per_subagent_call
Phase budgets must not be exceeded without justification
Agent MUST load contract.json before any tool call
rules.message: ⛔ PREFLIGHT FAILED: contract.json not loaded. Run: lean-ctx ctx_knowledge recall --query "orchestration-contract"

rules.description: Agent MUST NOT work on main branch
rules.message: ⛔ PREFLIGHT FAILED: Current branch is main. Create a feature branch first.

rules.description: Agent MUST validate contract.state before proceeding
rules.message: ⛔ STATE FAILED: Contract state is ${actual}. Expected one of: ${expected}

rules.description: Agent MUST run gitnexus_impact before editing any symbol
rules.message: ⛔ IMPACT FAILED: Edit attempted without gitnexus_impact analysis. Run: gitnexus_impact({target, direction: "upstream"})

rules.description: Agent MUST persist contract after every delegation/phase change
rules.message: ⚠️ PERSIST WARNING: Contract not persisted after delegation. Run: lean-ctx ctx_knowledge remember category architecture key orchestration-contract value <updated JSON>

rules.description: Scoring MUST be computed after each subagent returns
rules.message: ⚠️ SCORE WARNING: Subagent output not scored. Run scoring pipeline (Tier 1 rules + Tier 2 judge)

rules.description: Agent MUST follow writing order: Port → Service → Mapper → Adapter → Constants → Events → Tests
rules.message: ⛔ WRITING ORDER: Files created in wrong order. Expected order: port → service → mapper → adapter → constants → events → tests

rules.description: Agent MUST push feature branch before significant work
rules.message: ⚠️ BRANCH WARNING: Feature branch exists but not pushed. Run: git push -u origin $(git branch --show-current)

rules.description: Agent MUST use lean-ctx ctx_shell for all shell commands. bash tool is denied — triggers permission prompts and blocks automation.
rules.message: ⛔ SHELL VIOLATION: Use lean-ctx ctx_shell for shell commands. bash is denied in opencode.json — triggers permission prompts and blocks automation.

rules.description: Agent MUST use lean-ctx ctx_shell for all shell commands. Native bash/snip triggers permission prompts and blocks automation.
rules.message: ⛔ SHELL VIOLATION: Native bash/snip detected. Use lean-ctx ctx_shell instead — it compresses output and avoids permission prompts.

rules.description: Learner agent MUST update ALL 11 memory systems in post-flight matrix
rules.message: ⚠️ LEARNER WARNING: Not all memory systems updated. See AGENTS.md §1.7 for full matrix.

rules.description: Tier 2 LLM judge MUST use the canonical judge prompt from rules.json scoring.tier2.judge_prompt or templates/judge-prompt.md
rules.message: ⚠️ SCORE WARNING: Judge prompt must use canonical source. See .opencode/rules/rules.json scoring.tier2.judge_prompt

rules.description: Scoring pipeline MUST complete within timeout_ms — a hung scoring call blocks orchestration flow
rules.message: ⚠️ SCORE TIMEOUT: Scoring pipeline exceeded configured timeout. Set state=BLOCKED with issue 'scoring_timeout'.

rules.description: PLAN_SCORED→EXECUTE transition requires SDD spec approval (score ≥ 70). Exempt: trivial bug fixes, config-only, documentation-only.
rules.message: ⛔ SDD GATE FAILED: EXECUTE attempted without approved spec. Run system-analyst with 'mode: spec' first, then score spec ≥ 70.

rules.description: Before parallel fan-out, run gitnexus_detect_changes() on all shard files to check for overlap conflicts
rules.message: ⚠️ PARALLEL CONFLICT RISK: Fanning out without conflict detection. Run gitnexus_detect_changes() on ALL shard files first.

rules.description: Agent MUST run gitnexus_detect_changes() before committing to verify only expected files changed
rules.message: ⚠️ POSTFLIGHT WARNING: Commit attempted without gitnexus_detect_changes(). Run gitnexus_detect_changes() to verify file scope.

rules.description: Agent MUST persist knowledge to lean-ctx after task completion — gotchas, patterns, decisions discovered during the task
rules.message: ⚠️ POSTFLIGHT WARNING: Task completed without persisting new knowledge. Run: lean-ctx ctx_knowledge remember category <category> key <key> value <value>

rules.description: Agent MUST update STATE.md after each phase or task completion — append completed work, update Current Focus and Known Blockers
rules.message: ⚠️ POSTFLIGHT WARNING: Task completed without updating STATE.md. Update Current Focus and Known Blockers to reflect work done.

rules.description: Agent MUST use lean-ctx ctx_read for file reads. Native read is blocked in opencode.json permission — agents CANNOT invoke it.
rules.message: ⛔ READ BLOCKED: Native read is denied in opencode.json permission + per-agent tools. Use lean-ctx ctx_read or ctx_multi_read instead.

rules.description: Agent MUST use lean-ctx ctx_edit for file edits. Native edit is blocked in opencode.json permission — agents CANNOT invoke it.
rules.message: ⛔ EDIT BLOCKED: Native edit is denied in opencode.json permission + per-agent tools. Use lean-ctx ctx_edit instead.

rules.description: Agent MUST use lean-ctx ctx_search for code search. Native grep is blocked in opencode.json permission — agents CANNOT invoke it.
rules.message: ⛔ GREP BLOCKED: Native grep is denied in opencode.json permission + per-agent tools. Use lean-ctx ctx_search for regex code searches.

rules.description: Code simplicity/frugality check: reject unnecessary abstractions, unused deps, over-engineered patterns, YAGNI violations
rules.message: ⚠️ SIMPLICITY: Unnecessary abstraction detected — ponytail ladder skipped? Check: (1) Could stdlib replace this? (2) Is every abstraction justified? (3) Could any file be eliminated?

rules.description: State transition audit — if a state transition completes without appending to audit_log, deduct -15 from score
rules.message: ⛔ AUDIT FAILED: State transition detected without corresponding audit_log entry. Append {timestamp, prev_state, new_state, triggered_by, transition_reason, scoring_snapshot} before persisting.

rules.description: Stalled phase detection — if >5 transitions without state change, advisory warning
rules.message: ⚠️ AUDIT ADVISORY: Detected >5 consecutive transitions without state change. Phase may be stalled. Investigate before continuing.

rules.description: Score regression — if score drops >20pts between adjacent audit entries in the same phase, deduct -15
rules.message: ⛔ REGRESSION DETECTED: Score dropped >20 points between adjacent audit entries in the same phase. Investigate root cause immediately.

tier2.judge_prompt: You are an impartial judge evaluating an AI agent's output. Score 0-100 based on: (1) Requirements fulfillment 0-40, (2) Governance compliance 0-30, (3) Completeness 0-20, (4) Edge cases and risks 0-10. Return JSON: { score: N, rationale: '...', missing_items: [...] }
